description: Lists your quotes, newest first (200 at most; pass limit and cursor to page). Every row carries total_cents (integer CENTS) and effective_status, so an expired quote reads 'expired'. Refuses a limit outside 1-200 or a malformed cursor with VALIDATION_ERROR: resend without them, or with next_cursor exactly as returned.

cursor.description: Opaque page cursor — pass a previous response's next_cursor verbatim. null next_cursor means no further pages.

limit.description: Page size 1-200. Omit BOTH limit and cursor for the legacy bare-array first page of 200; pass either to get { items, next_cursor, limit } instead.

name: quote_list
